name: Izayah Vickers
strengths: Vickers mirrors receivers in press with sticky feet and does not panic when stems get sticky.
Vickers closes throwing windows quickly — track background shows in how he recovers when beaten a step.
Vickers is willing to be physical at the catch point and does not play soft off the line.
weaknesses: Vickers can get grabby late in routes when he loses leverage — technique polish is the next step versus SEC length.
comparison: Vickers comps to Trent McDuffie — compact 5-11 press/man corner with twitch, physicality, and recovery speed in phase.
projection: Vickers projects as a Year 2 SEC starter at CB (nickel / special teams Year 1). Ceiling: every-down SEC press corner — the twitchy man cover piece with track juice who can lock the perimeter.
schemeFit: Vickers fits White’s press/man + pattern-match CB who wins with twitch and physicality on the perimeter.
